entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
My VeloBand Pulse is not working.
I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or...?
It's broken. It just won't sync with the app anymore. I've tried everything. It's defective.
I see. I apologize for the trouble you're having with the device. Let me pull up your account. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered 41 days ago. Since you're saying the item is defective, let me check our return eligibility for you.

Alright, I'm just checking the knowledge base... Yes, I see here that all our items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. Since you're at day 41, you are unfortunately outside that window. I can go ahead and cannot offer a refund for you.
Whatever. Just send me the label.

Of course. I've just initiated the return. You will receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office.
Yes, that's all. Once we receive the defective unit, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Okay. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
